title: Satellite hire onramp cheatsheet + panel interview protocol
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational cheat-sheet for hiring and onboarding hires based in small satellite locations (co-working, regional offices, or individual remote hires) paired with a lightweight panel interview protocol tuned for quick calibration across hiring managers and interviewers.

Audience:
- People Ops (recruiter + regional onboarding buddy)
- Hiring managers with satellite hires
- Interview panel members (eng/product/ux)

Status: draft (working doc). Use for Q2 pilot hires in APAC/EMEA satellite offices.

Quick summary (tl;dr):
- Reduce friction: pre-provision laptop and VPN day-before start; confirm shipping/travel logistics early.
- Panel interview: 60–75 min structured session with evidence-led scoring (5 categories).
- First 2 weeks onboarding: condensed local admin + remote integration checklist.

-- PANEL INTERVIEW PROTOCOL --
Goal: gather reproducible evidence across technical depth, practical debugging, system thinking, collaboration, and role judgment. Keep to ~3 interviewers + hiring manager observe or 4th as tie-breaker.

Panel composition (recommended):
- Interviewer 1: Senior IC (role-specific coding/system questions)
- Interviewer 2: Staff/Tech lead (design/architecture + integration)
- Interviewer 3: Product/PM or peer (product sense and cross-team collaboration)
- Hiring manager: joins for 10–15m at the end for culture fit and logistics Qs (optional to watch earlier)

Interview length: 60–75 min total
- 5 min: quick intros and logistics
- 35–45 min: core evaluation (coding/design/problem solving) split across interviewers
- 10–15 min: behavioral + product/context questions
- 5–10 min: wrap + candidate questions

Scoring (evidence-based, 1–5 scale; record 2–3 bullets of evidence):
- Technical correctness (1–5): correct approach, trade-offs considered, common edge cases handled
- System/architecture thinking (1–5): ability to scale, persist, observe, handle failure modes
- Practical debugging & readings (1–5): finds root cause, uses metrics/logs, iterative narrowing
- Collaboration & communication (1–5): explains trade-offs, invites feedback, cross-team clarity
- Role judgment & scope (1–5): prioritizes work, understands product impact, autonomy level

Pass threshold guidance (hiring manager calibrates by role):
- IC2/IC3: avg >= 3.5 with no category < 3
- Senior/Staff: avg >= 4.0 with no category < 3

Sample prompts (rotate, keep short):
- Coding prompt (20–30m): implement a simplified streaming KV cache API. Focus on API design, edge cases (eviction/TTL), and one optimization. Emphasize thought process over perfect code.
- System prompt (20m): design a model-serving request router that handles region failover and variant fallback. Ask for trade-offs (latency vs cost) and how to test.
- Debug prompt (15m): given a brief alert timeline and partial logs (slow tails), diagnose probable root causes and propose 3 concrete mitigations.
- Behavioral/product (10m): tell us about a time you had to cut scope to hit an SLA; how did you decide what to cut and communicate to stakeholders?

Interview logistics checklist (recruiter owns unless delegated):
- Confirm timezone and candidate hardware constraints 48–72h prior
- Send panel schedule with rubrics and links 24h prior
- Attach short context doc (one-pager): team mission, relevant repos/stack, example issues
- Ensure candidate can share screen; provide a non-coding whiteboard option if bandwidth is low
- Backup interviewer: assign a backup in case of last-minute cancellations

Calibration notes (people-ops / hiring manager):
- Run a 30m calibration session monthly for interviewers on the rubric using 1–2 redacted past interviews
- Keep notes on per-interviewer scoring bias and adjust pass thresholds accordingly

-- SATELLITE HIRE ONRAMP (FIRST 2 WEEKS) --
Objectives: minimize admin friction, integrate into team rhythms, and provide a bonded buddy/local contact.

Pre-day 0 (recruiter / ops):
- Confirm start date + timezone + local co-working details
- Ship company laptop + power adapter + pre-installed VPN image (track shipment with courier)
- Create account provisioning checklist: email, SSO, GitHub/GitLab, Slack, Redwood infra access group, time-tracking
- Calendar: set up 1:1s (manager, buddy), orientation block, team standup invite

Day 0 checklist (manager + buddy):
- Welcome call (30m): intro to team, expectations for week 1, and local logistics
- Local admin: expense policy walkthrough, banking/contract checklist, co-working pass activation
- IT/Access: verify laptop boots, VPN connects, SSO works, repo access confirmed
- Buddy assignment: shadowing schedule, 1:1 pairing slots for codebase walkthrough

Week 1 (owner: buddy + manager):
- Codebase primer (2 hrs): guided walkthrough of core services and small guided PR to build confidence
- Sprint onboarding task: assigned a single scoped ticket that results in a merged PR and shipping notes
- Observe/Attending: team standups, triage, and architecture syncs listed on calendar
- 1:1 at EoW: quick pulse, blockers, and learning plan adjustments

Week 2 (owner: manager):
- Deeper domain pairing: 1 full day pairing with cross-functional peer
- Security & compliance refresh: localized policy review and any required attestations
- 30-day success plan reviewed: outcomes, signals, and follow-ups scheduled

Checklist items (operational):
- Local reimbursements: preloaded expense guide + preferred vendor list
- Timezone-aware meeting norms: core hours suggested but flexible - add to bio
- Co-working reimbursements: attach policy and accounting flow

Manager quick script (first 15m call):
- "Welcome — excited you're here. Short-term goal: ship a small change in week 1 so you feel the loop. Your buddy is X. We meet weekly; immediate blockers ping me in Slack. Anything you need today?"

Success signals (first 30 days):
- PR merged and released for scoped ticket
- Buddy + manager give green on technical ramp
- Candidate has attended all required syncs and introduced self in 3 cross-team channels

Risks & mitigation (common for satellite hires):
- Risk: shipping delays -> Mitigation: loaner remote image, remote VPN test prior to ship
- Risk: isolation / async misalignment -> Mitigation: weekly pairing hours + scheduled overlap windows
- Risk: slow access provisioning -> Mitigation: pre-approve access groups and expedite via SRE on-call

Templates (copy & paste)
- Recruiter invite message (to candidate):
  "Hi <Name>, excited to confirm your start date (DATE). We'll be shipping your laptop by COURIER. Please expect tracking and a quick laptop setup call on DAY -1. Panel schedule and team one-pagers attached. Please reply if you have any access/OS constraints. — Priya"

- Panel interviewer note (to attach to calendar invite):
  "Please use the rubric in the event. Record 2–3 bullets of direct evidence per category and a quick recommendation (hire/bench/no-hire). Remember to call out assumptions the candidate made. If bandwidth limited, focus on system/design or debugging prompt. — People Ops"

Notes to self / open questions:
- Pilot metric: measure time-to-first-PR and first-90-day retention for satellite hires vs. HQ hires.
- Evaluate hiring funnel conversion for remote vs in-region candidates after 5 hires
- Need a localized vendor for next-day laptop spare stock in APAC (Jira HR-782)

References / quick links:
- Confluence: HR/Onboarding-satellite-template
- Recruiting board: JIRA HR-782
- Slack: #hiring-platform for live escalations

Appendix: Example short rubric (copy into interviewer form)
- For each category add score 1–5 and 2 evidence bullets:
  Technical correctness: [ ]1 [ ]2 [ ]3 [ ]4 [ ]5
  System thinking: [ ]1 [ ]2 [ ]3 [ ]4 [ ]5
  Debugging & readings: [ ]1 [ ]2 [ ]3 [ ]4 [ ]5
  Collaboration & comms: [ ]1 [ ]2 [ ]3 [ ]4 [ ]5
  Role judgment: [ ]1 [ ]2 [ ]3 [ ]4 [ ]5
  Overall recommendation: HIRE / BENCH / NO-HIRE

End of doc.
